description: What the EnvoyDev window may ask the shell to do. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is here because this app draws its own title bar: Tauri v2 gates both `data-tauri-drag-region` and an explicit drag request behind that command, `core:default` does not include it, and the refusal is silent — the window simply does not move, with nothing in the log to say why.
